_comment: Translation template for Lucky All Around. Copy this file, rename it to the target language code (e.g. ru.json, zh.json), and replace each English value with the translated string.

options.pityIntro: Configure how exclusive, player-seeded pity events are weighted.
options.forceModeDescription: Force mode replaces the vanilla tier for every pity event. Native 8x and 10x tiers can be reduced to {multiplier}x.
options.neverWorseModeDescription: Never Worse mode keeps higher vanilla tiers and only raises lower tiers up to at least {multiplier}x.
options.rarityIntro: Boost your chances of encountering rare items and events while exploring without altering actual drop quantities or combat difficulty. Higher multipliers dramatically increase how frequently these rare events appear.
